events.title: Wärtsilä FOS-Onboard (Update A)
events.summary: Wärtsilä FOS-Onboard Update A contains two critical CVEs that could let attackers deliver unauthorized updates, execute code, or steal credentials, impacting transportation systems worldwide.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerabilities have CVSS scores of 9.5 and 9.3, indicating high risk. Exploitation could allow attackers to execute code or impersonate privileged clients, potentially compromising transportation infrastructure.

events.title: mySCADA myPRO Manager
events.summary: Vulnerabilities in mySCADA myPRO Manager allow attackers to gain privileged management access or send arbitrary SMS via the connected GSM modem. Versions up to 2.1 are affected.
events.why_it_matters: The high CVSS score of 9.3 indicates a severe risk, and the missing authentication could let attackers control critical manufacturing, energy, and transportation systems.
